Jwt.//Key: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret for access tokens, at least 32 bytes. NEVER stored here. Development mints a random one per process (tokens then die with the API); every other environment REFUSES TO START without it. Set it with 'dotnet user-secrets set Jwt:Key <secret>' locally, or Jwt__Key from a secret store in production.
Jwt.//AccessTokenMinutes: Token lifetime in minutes, 1 to 525600 (one year). Default: 43200 (30 days). The SPA renews the token every time it starts and every 12 hours while open, so a learner who opens the app inside this window is never signed out. There is no refresh-token store, so this is also the window in which a token cannot be revoked - a password change does not end a session already in flight. Shorten it for anywhere less trusted than one person's machine.

Database.//MigrateOnStartup: Applies pending migrations at startup. Defaults to true in Development and false elsewhere: two instances racing the same migration is a deployment hazard. Leave it off in production and run 'dotnet ef database update' from the deploy pipeline.
Database.//SeedOnStartup: Seeds exam blueprints, starter questions and the embedded reference banks. Idempotent, so it is safe to leave on. Default: true.

Hosting.//UseHttpsRedirection: Redirects http to https and sends HSTS. Defaults to false in Development and true elsewhere. Set it to false when TLS is terminated by a proxy that does not forward X-Forwarded-Proto.

Cors.//: Origins allowed to call this API from a browser. Must list the deployed SPA origin; an unlisted origin is refused.

RateLimits.//: Per-learner limits on the endpoints that cost provider quota or CPU, plus a per-address ceiling. Set Enabled to false only when an upstream gateway enforces its own.

Admin.//ApiKey: Shared secret required by the destructive endpoints (delete a question, apply an audit cleanup), sent in the X-Admin-Key header. Keep it in user-secrets, an environment variable or a key vault - never in this file. Unset means those endpoints stay open in Development and are refused everywhere else.

Lessons.//: Teaching policy for the lessons tab. Bound and validated at startup.

Tutor.//: Bounds on the ask-about-this-lesson panel, so one request cannot become an unbounded prompt.

Questions.//: How much context the generator is given, and what counts as an undercovered topic.

Exams.//: DeadlineGraceSeconds allows for clock skew between the browser countdown and the server.

Pipeline.//: Requests slower than this are logged at Information rather than Debug.

Ai.//: Provider: Gemini | Groq | DeepSeek | Offline. Keep API keys in user-secrets or env vars, never in this file.
Ai.//Keys: One key per provider, e.g. Ai:Keys:Gemini and Ai:Keys:DeepSeek, so several can be configured at once and switching provider needs no key change. Falls back to Ai:ApiKey, then to GEMINI_API_KEY / GROQ_API_KEY / DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
